'''2012 Canadian Nationals Tim LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
